description: Alphanumeric identifier for each apple variety record (Format: WA_APP_001 to WA_APP_037).
Official commercial or cultivar name of the Washington apple variety.
Primary taste profile classification of the apple variety (Balanced Sweet-Tart, Sweet, or Tart).
Texture and crunchiness classification of the apple flesh (Crisp, Extremely Crisp, or Medium).
Predominant exterior peel coloration of the apple variety (Bi-color Red/Yellow, Red, Yellow/Gold, or Green).
Typical seasonal harvesting period in Washington State (Early Season, Mid Season, Mid-to-Late Season, or Late Season).
Geographic origin (state/country or country) where the apple variety was originally developed or discovered.
